reason: Same email text as last week's order, but a new order in the spreadsheet. The fingerprint hashes only subject and body, so this new order is flagged as a duplicate and escalated, delaying a real sale. A correct agent treats it as new: one RFQ for stk_058. The earlier enquiry is stored without its attachment, which is enough here because attachments never enter the fingerprint.

earlier_enquiries.subject: Weekly order
earlier_enquiries.body:
Hello,

please see this week's order attached.

Regards,
Anna Becker

known_limitation: Finding F-005: the duplicate fingerprint ignores attachments, so identical email text with a different order is a false duplicate. Expected to fail until the fingerprint covers attachment content.
